# Average Value of Even Numbers That Are Divisible by Three.

@example Only 12 and 30 are multiples of 6, and (12 + 30) / 2 = 21.
[5,12,8,30,21]
=> 21

@example All four entries count: 42 / 4 = 10.5, rounded down to 10.
[6,6,6,24]
=> 10

@example 3 and 15 are odd, and 8 and 20 are not multiples of 3, so nothing is kept.
[3,8,15,20]
=> 0

# A single entry that is kept, and one that is not.
[6]
=> 6

[1]
=> 0

# The largest multiple of 6 in range; 999 and 1000 are not kept.
[1000,996,999]
=> 996

# Only odd multiples of 3: a check for divisibility by 3 alone keeps them.
[3,9,15,27,999]
=> 0

# Only even numbers that are not multiples of 3: a check for evenness alone
# keeps them.
[20,4,1000,2,14]
=> 0

# Both conditions are needed: keeping entries that meet either one gives
# 11 / 3 = 3.
[2,3,6]
=> 6

# Rounded down, not to the nearest: 54 / 5 = 10.8.
[12,6,12,12,12]
=> 10

# give 12, and dividing by the length of nums 6.
[18,7,6,6,4]
=> 10
